fullText.simplified:
结婚

    刘向一直看着华三，他很希望华三能留下来。
    华三低着头，想了很久。最后，像是做了决定。她看了看天，说：“那只黑虎还是有点儿本领的，我不能走了。”
    刘向不明白，华三对他笑了笑，然后伸出手，刘向的脸一下子就白了。他看到华三的手也变黑了！他又着急又担心，眼睛马上就红了。
    华三笑着对他说：“没事，我是神仙，睡一觉就好了。”
    刘向还是很害怕，他拉起华三的手，刚想说话，华三就已经睡过去了。刘向小心地把她抱回家，让她好好休息。
    华三睡了两天，刘向小心地照顾着她，自己一刻也不休息。第三天，华三醒了，她的手已经不黑了。刘向高兴得像个小孩，拉着她的手又哭又笑。
    华三看着他，也笑了。
    华三不走了。后来，她和刘向结婚了。
    结婚以后，他们开了一家医馆，给大家看病。华三治好了很多人，别的村子的人也来找她看病，大家都很感谢她，说她是活神仙。刘向听到以后，总是在心里笑，没有人知道，大家感谢的“华姑娘”是真正的神仙。
    第二年，华三生下了一个可爱的男孩，名字叫成香。成香胖胖的脸蛋，红红的小嘴，黑黑的头发，非常可爱。他们过得很幸福，但是细心的刘向还是会发现，有时候华三会看着天空，像是在想着什么，在担心着什么。
    华三的家在天上，和刘向结婚以后，华三再也没有回去过。刘向明白，华三这么好的一个神仙能和自己一个人类结婚，是多么不容易的事。所以，他特别感谢华三，对华三也特别好。
    幸福的日子过了半年，有一天，家里来了一位客人。华三一看到这位客人，脸上的笑立刻就消失了。
fullText.traditional:
結婚

    劉向一直看著華三，他很希望華三能留下來。
    華三低著頭，想了很久。最後，像是做了決定。她看了看天，說：“那隻黑虎還是有點兒本領的，我不能走了。”
    劉向不明白，華三對他笑了笑，然後伸出手，劉向的臉一下子就白了。他看到華三的手也變黑了！他又著急又擔心，眼睛馬上就紅了。
    華三笑著對他說：“沒事，我是神仙，睡一覺就好了。”
    劉向還是很害怕，他拉起華三的手，剛想說話，華三就已經睡過去了。劉向小心地把她抱回家，讓她好好休息。
    華三睡了兩天，劉向小心地照顧著她，自己一刻也不休息。第三天，華三醒了，她的手已經不黑了。劉向高興得像個小孩，拉著她的手又哭又笑。
    華三看著他，也笑了。
    華三不走了。後來，她和劉向結婚了。
    結婚以後，他們開了一家醫館，給大家看病。華三治好了很多人，別的村子的人也來找她看病，大家都很感謝她，說她是活神仙。劉向聽到以後，總是在心裡笑，沒有人知道，大家感謝的“華姑娘”是真正的神仙。
    第二年，華三生下了一個可愛的男孩，名字叫成香。成香胖胖的臉蛋，紅紅的小嘴，黑黑的頭髮，非常可愛。他們過得很幸福，但是細心的劉向還是會發現，有時候華三會看著天空，像是在想著什麼，在擔心著什麼。
    華三的家在天上，和劉向結婚以後，華三再也沒有回去過。劉向明白，華三這麼好的一個神仙能和自己一個人類結婚，是多麼不容易的事。所以，他特別感謝華三，對華三也特別好。
    幸福的日子過了半年，有一天，家裡來了一位客人。華三一看到這位客人，臉上的笑立刻就消失了。

sentences.simplified: 刘向一直看着华三，他很希望华三能留下来。
sentences.traditional: 劉向一直看著華三，他很希望華三能留下來。
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng yì zhí kàn zhe huà sān tā hěn xī wàng huà sān néng liú xià lai
sentences.english: Liu Xiang kept looking at Hua San. He really hoped that Hua San would stay.

sentences.simplified: 华三低着头，想了很久。最后，像是做了决定。
sentences.traditional: 華三低著頭，想了很久。最後，像是做了決定。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān dī zhe tóu xiǎng le hěn jiǔ zuì hòu xiàng shì zuò le jué dìng
sentences.english: Hua San lowered her head and thought for a long time. Finally, it seemed that she had made a decision.

sentences.simplified: 她看了看天，说：“那只黑虎还是有点儿本领的，我不能走了。”
sentences.traditional: 她看了看天，說：“那隻黑虎還是有點兒本領的，我不能走了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le kàn tiān shuō nà zhī hēi hǔ hái shì yǒu diǎn'r běn lǐng de wǒ bù néng zǒu le
sentences.english: She looked at the sky and said, “That black tiger still has some abilities. I can’t leave.”

sentences.simplified: 刘向不明白，华三对他笑了笑，然后伸出手，
sentences.traditional: 劉向不明白，華三對他笑了笑，然後伸出手，
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng bù míng bai huà sān duì tā xiào le xiào rán hòu shēn chū shǒu
sentences.english: Liu Xiang did not understand. Hua San smiled at him, then extended her hand.

sentences.simplified: 刘向的脸一下子就白了。他看到华三的手也变黑了！
sentences.traditional: 劉向的臉一下子就白了。他看到華三的手也變黑了！
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng de liǎn yí xià zi jiù bái le tā kàn dào huà sān de shǒu yě biàn hēi le
sentences.english: Liu Xiang’s face went white at once. He saw that Hua San’s hand had also turned black!

sentences.simplified: 他又着急又担心，眼睛马上就红了。
sentences.traditional: 他又著急又擔心，眼睛馬上就紅了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu zháo jí yòu dān xīn yǎn jing mǎ shàng jiù hóng le
sentences.english: He was anxious and worried, and his eyes immediately turned red.

sentences.simplified: 华三笑着对他说：“没事，我是神仙，睡一觉就好了。”
sentences.traditional: 華三笑著對他說：“沒事，我是神仙，睡一覺就好了。”
sentences.pinyin: huà sān xiào zhe duì tā shuō méi shì wǒ shì shén xiān shuì yí jiào jiù hǎo le
sentences.english: Hua San smiled and said to him, “It’s okay, I’m an immortal. I’ll be fine after a good sleep.”

sentences.simplified: 刘向还是很害怕，他拉起华三的手，刚想说话，
sentences.traditional: 劉向還是很害怕，他拉起華三的手，剛想說話，
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng hái shi hěn hài pà tā lā qǐ huà sān de shǒu gāng xiǎng shuō huà
sentences.english: Liu Xiang was still scared. He took Hua San’s hand and was just about to say something.

sentences.simplified: 华三就已经睡过去了。刘向小心地把她抱回家，让她好好休息。
sentences.traditional: 華三就已經睡過去了。劉向小心地把她抱回家，讓她好好休息。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān jiù yǐ jīng shuì guò qù le liú xiàng xiǎo xīn de bǎ tā bào huí jiā ràng tā hǎo hǎo xiū xi
sentences.english: But Hua San had already fallen asleep. Liu Xiang carefully carried her home and let her rest.

sentences.simplified: 华三睡了两天，刘向小心地照顾着她，自己一刻也不休息。
sentences.traditional: 華三睡了兩天，劉向小心地照顧著她，自己一刻也不休息。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān shuì le liǎng tiān liú xiàng xiǎo xīn de zhào gù zhe tā zì jǐ yí kè yě bù xiū xi
sentences.english: Hua San slept for two days. Liu Xiang carefully cared for her and did not rest for a moment.

sentences.simplified: 第三天，华三醒了，她的手已经不黑了。
sentences.traditional: 第三天，華三醒了，她的手已經不黑了。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān tiān huà sān xǐng le tā de shǒu yǐ jīng bù hēi le
sentences.english: On the third day, Hua San woke up, and her hand was no longer black.

sentences.simplified: 刘向高兴得像个小孩，拉着她的手又哭又笑。
sentences.traditional: 劉向高興得像個小孩，拉著她的手又哭又笑。
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng gāo xìng de xiàng ge xiǎo hái lā zhe tā de shǒu yòu kū yòu xiào
sentences.english: Liu Xiang was as happy as a child, holding her hand both crying and laughing.

sentences.simplified: 华三看着他，也笑了。
sentences.traditional: 華三看著他，也笑了。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān kàn zhe tā yě xiào le
sentences.english: Hua San looked at him and smiled too.

sentences.simplified: 华三不走了。后来，她和刘向结婚了。
sentences.traditional: 華三不走了。後來，她和劉向結婚了。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān bù zǒu le hòu lái tā hé liú xiàng jié hūn le
sentences.english: Hua San didn’t leave. Later, she and Liu Xiang got married.

sentences.simplified: 结婚以后，他们开了一家医馆，给大家看病。
sentences.traditional: 結婚以後，他們開了一家醫館，給大家看病。
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn yǐ hòu tā men kāi le yì jiā yī guǎn gěi dà jiā kàn bìng
sentences.english: After they got married, they opened a hospital and gave medical treatment to everyone.

sentences.simplified: 华三治好了很多人，别的村子的人也来找她看病，
sentences.traditional: 華三治好了很多人，別的村子的人也來找她看病，
sentences.pinyin: huà sān zhì hǎo le hěn duō rén bié de cūn zi de rén yě lái zhǎo tā kàn bìng
sentences.english: Hua San cured a lot of people. People from other villages also came to see her.

sentences.simplified: 大家都很感谢她，说她是活神仙。
sentences.traditional: 大家都很感謝她，說她是活神仙。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu hěn gǎn xiè tā shuō tā shì huó shén xiān
sentences.english: Everyone was very grateful to her, saying that she was a living immortal.

sentences.simplified: 刘向听到以后，总是在心里笑，
sentences.traditional: 劉向聽到以後，總是在心裡笑，
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng tīng dào yǐ hòu zǒng shì zài xīn li xiào
sentences.english: Liu Xiang always smiled on the inside when he heard that.

sentences.simplified: 没有人知道，大家感谢的“华姑娘”是真正的神仙。
sentences.traditional: 沒有人知道，大家感謝的“華姑娘”是真正的神仙。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén zhī dào dà jiā gǎn xiè de huà gū niang shì zhēn zhèng de shén xiān
sentences.english: No one knew that the “Miss Hua” that everyone was thanking was a real immortal.

sentences.simplified: 第二年，华三生下了一个可爱的男孩，名字叫成香。
sentences.traditional: 第二年，華三生下了一個可愛的男孩，名字叫成香。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr nián huà sān shēng xià le yí ge kě ài de nán hái míng zi jiào chéng xiāng
sentences.english: The next year, Hua San gave birth to a cute boy named Chengxiang.

sentences.simplified: 成香胖胖的脸蛋，红红的小嘴，黑黑的头发，非常可爱。
sentences.traditional: 成香胖胖的臉蛋，紅紅的小嘴，黑黑的頭髮，非常可愛。
sentences.pinyin: chéng xiāng pàng pàng de liǎn dàn hóng hóng de xiǎo zuǐ hēi hēi de tóu fa fēi cháng kě ài
sentences.english: Chengxiang had a chubby face, a little red mouth, black hair, and was very cute.

sentences.simplified: 他们过得很幸福，但是细心的刘向还是会发现，有时候华三会看着天空，
sentences.traditional: 他們過得很幸福，但是細心的劉向還是會發現，有時候華三會看著天空，
sentences.pinyin: tā men guò dé hěn xìng fú dàn shì xì xīn de liú xiàng hái shi huì fā xiàn yǒu shí hou huà sān huì kàn zhe tiān kōng
sentences.english: They lived a very happy life, but the attentive Liu Xiang still found that Hua San would sometimes look at the sky, ..

sentences.simplified: 像是在想着什么，在担心着什么。
sentences.traditional: 像是在想著什麼，在擔心著什麼。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng shì zài xiǎng zhe shén me zài dān xīn zhe shén me
sentences.english: .. as if thinking about something, worrying about something.

sentences.simplified: 华三的家在天上，和刘向结婚以后，华三再也没有回去过。
sentences.traditional: 華三的家在天上，和劉向結婚以後，華三再也沒有回去過。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān de jiā zài tiān shàng hé liú xiàng jié hūn yǐ hòu huà sān zài yě méi yǒu huí qù guò
sentences.english: Hua San’s family was in the heavens, and after marrying Liu Xiang, Hua San never went back.

sentences.simplified: 刘向明白，华三这么好的一个神仙能和自己一个人类结婚，是多么不容易的事。
sentences.traditional: 劉向明白，華三這麼好的一個神仙能和自己一個人類結婚，是多麼不容易的事。
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng míng bai huà sān zhè me hǎo de yí ge shén xiān néng hé zì jǐ yí ge rén lèi jié hūn shì duō me bù róng yì de shì
sentences.english: Liu Xiang understood that it couldn’t be easy for such a good immortal as Hua San to be married to a mortal like him.

sentences.simplified: 所以，他特别感谢华三，对华三也特别好。
sentences.traditional: 所以，他特別感謝華三，對華三也特別好。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā tè bié gǎn xiè huà sān duì huà sān yě tè bié hǎo
sentences.english: Therefore, he was particularly grateful to Hua San, and he treated her exceptionally well.

sentences.simplified: 幸福的日子过了半年，有一天，家里来了一位客人。
sentences.traditional: 幸福的日子過了半年，有一天，家裡來了一位客人。
sentences.pinyin: xìng fú de rì zi guò le bàn nián yǒu yì tiān jiā lǐ lái le yí wèi kè rén
sentences.english: Six months of happiness went by, and one day, a visitor came to the house.

sentences.simplified: 华三一看到这位客人，脸上的笑立刻就消失了。
sentences.traditional: 華三一看到這位客人，臉上的笑立刻就消失了。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān yí kàn dào zhè wèi kè rén liǎn shang de xiào lì kè jiù xiāo shī le
sentences.english: As soon as Hua San saw this visitor, the smile on her face immediately disappeared.

sentence_translations: Getting Married
Liu Xiang kept looking at Hua San. He really hoped that Hua San would stay.
Hua San lowered her head and thought for a long time. Finally, it seemed that she had made a decision.
She looked at the sky and said, “That black tiger still has some abilities. I can’t leave.”
Liu Xiang did not understand. Hua San smiled at him, then extended her hand.
Liu Xiang’s face went white at once. He saw that Hua San’s hand had also turned black!
He was anxious and worried, and his eyes immediately turned red.
Hua San smiled and said to him, “It’s okay, I’m an immortal. I’ll be fine after a good sleep.”
Liu Xiang was still scared. He took Hua San’s hand and was just about to say something.
But Hua San had already fallen asleep. Liu Xiang carefully carried her home and let her rest.
Hua San slept for two days. Liu Xiang carefully cared for her and did not rest for a moment.
On the third day, Hua San woke up, and her hand was no longer black.
Liu Xiang was as happy as a child, holding her hand both crying and laughing.
Hua San looked at him and smiled too.
Hua San didn’t leave. Later, she and Liu Xiang got married.
After they got married, they opened a hospital and gave medical treatment to everyone.
Hua San cured a lot of people. People from other villages also came to see her.
Everyone was very grateful to her, saying that she was a living immortal.
Liu Xiang always smiled on the inside when he heard that.
No one knew that the “Miss Hua” that everyone was thanking was a real immortal.
The next year, Hua San gave birth to a cute boy named Chengxiang.
Chengxiang had a chubby face, a little red mouth, black hair, and was very cute.
They lived a very happy life, but the attentive Liu Xiang still found that Hua San would sometimes look at the sky, ..
.. as if thinking about something, worrying about something.
Hua San’s family was in the heavens, and after marrying Liu Xiang, Hua San never went back.
Liu Xiang understood that it couldn’t be easy for such a good immortal as Hua San to be married to a mortal like him.
Therefore, he was particularly grateful to Hua San, and he treated her exceptionally well.
Six months of happiness went by, and one day, a visitor came to the house.
As soon as Hua San saw this visitor, the smile on her face immediately disappeared.
